verdict.rationale: Freshsales documents a broad first-party REST API covering CRUD across the core CRM objects (leads, contacts, deals, tasks, products, files, lists), plus custom modules, bulk upserts and job status, so much of the core data model is programmable. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows API parity with the UI, and several UI features (kanban pipeline views, Freddy AI scoring and recommendations, sales sequences, sandbox, field-level permissions, audit logs) have no documented API endpoints. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage for Freddy AI, sequences, permissions, audit logs and sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: such as reading, modifying, adding or deleting data from your helpdesk.
